name: [R25] Node.js process crash near Brotli context, consistent with CVE-2026-111497 -- exploratory heuristic, no published IOC
message:
Indicators of CVE-2026-111497, an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder that can leak memory or lead to RCE when decompressing attacker-controlled Brotli data, against Node.js itself (fixed 2026-10-21 in 22.23.4/24.22.1/26.12.1). As of 2026-10-25, this Node.js fix is independently corroborated via multiple secondary security-news outlets. See R24 for the PyPI brotli/brotlicffi sibling of this rule.

NO VENDOR OR RESEARCHER HAS PUBLISHED A REQUEST-LEVEL OR LOG-LEVEL IOC for this CVE against Node.js itself -- this is this repo's own constructed heuristic, not a confirmed signature: a Node.js process crash (SIGSEGV/segfault/core dump/fatal error, including common process-manager restart lines) near "brotli" context. Weak, unconfirmed signal -- treat a hit as a lead, not evidence. Confirm the running Node.js version with scripts/node_version_check.py.

queries.name: nodejs_crash_near_brotli_context
queries.query: (@message:*SIGSEGV* OR @message:*"Segmentation fault"* OR @message:*"core dumped"* OR @message:*"FATAL ERROR"* OR @message:*"signal 11"*) (@message:*brotli* OR @message:*Brotli* OR @message:*"Content-Encoding: br"* OR @message:*"zlib.js"*)
